description:
Create a new Excalidraw diagram from a RAW, hand-authored scene — you control every
element's position, size, color, stroke, fill, typography, and connections. This is the
path for RICH, BEAUTIFUL, custom diagrams (architecture diagrams, polished flows, anything
where layout and styling matter). Prefer this over generate_diagram unless the user just
wants a quick auto-laid-out flowchart. Author elements TERSELY — give the fields that
matter and the Excalidraw boilerplate is filled in for you. Returns the diagram id, title,
and editor url. Each call creates a NEW diagram and counts against your quota; to refine an
existing one, prefer regenerate_diagram / patch_elements (on quota_exceeded, trash_diagram
frees a slot).

Note: `scene.appState` is accepted but NOT persisted in v1 — it is always `{}` on read.
Author view/canvas state through the `elements`, not appState.

Authored Excalidraw scene = { "elements": [ ... ] }. Author each element TERSELY — give the meaningful fields and the rest are filled with Excalidraw defaults. Required per element: id (unique), type, x, y (top-left).

Element types: rectangle | ellipse | diamond | text | arrow | line | freedraw | frame | image.
Geometry: x, y, width, height (for shapes), angle (radians, rotation). Array order = paint order (later elements draw on top).
Style: strokeColor, backgroundColor (or "transparent"), fillStyle (hachure|cross-hatch|solid|zigzag), strokeWidth, strokeStyle (solid|dashed|dotted), roughness (0 precise | 1 default | 2 sketchy), opacity (0-100), roundness (null = sharp corners | { "type": 3 } = rounded).
Text: set "text"; fontSize, fontFamily (1 hand-drawn | 2 normal | 3 code | 5 default), textAlign, verticalAlign. To label a shape, add a text element with "containerId" = the shape id (it auto-centers; the reciprocal binding is filled for you).
Arrows/lines: "points" are [dx,dy] offsets from the element x/y (e.g. [[0,0],[120,0]]); set "elbowed": true for orthogonal routing; startArrowhead/endArrowhead (arrow|triangle|dot|bar|diamond|...|null). Bind ends to shapes with startBinding/endBinding = { "elementId": "<shape id>", "focus": 0, "gap": 4 }.
Grouping: shared "groupIds". Frames: a "frame" element + members' "frameId".

Design for beauty: lay shapes on a grid with generous spacing (~80-120px between nodes), keep sizes/strokeWidth consistent, use a small coherent palette with one accent color, and center labels in their containers. Recommended palette — stroke #1e1e1e; blue #1971c2/#a5d8ff; green #2f9e44/#b2f2bb; red #e03131/#ffc9c9; yellow #f08c00/#ffec99; violet #6741d9/#d0bfff.

Worked example (scene):
{
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "title",
      "type": "text",
      "x": 220,
      "y": 40,
      "text": "Request flow",
      "fontSize": 28,
      "fontFamily": 2,
      "strokeColor": "#1e1e1e"
    },
    {
      "id": "client",
      "type": "rectangle",
      "x": 200,
      "y": 120,
      "width": 160,
      "height": 70,
      "strokeColor": "#1971c2",
      "backgroundColor": "#a5d8ff",
      "fillStyle": "solid",
      "roundness": {
        "type": 3
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "client-label",
      "type": "text",
      "x": 200,
      "y": 120,
      "text": "Client",
      "containerId": "client",
      "fontFamily": 2
    },
    {
      "id": "api",
      "type": "rectangle",
      "x": 200,
      "y": 280,
      "width": 160,
      "height": 70,
      "strokeColor": "#2f9e44",
      "backgroundColor": "#b2f2bb",
      "fillStyle": "solid",
      "roundness": {
        "type": 3
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "api-label",
      "type": "text",
      "x": 200,
      "y": 280,
      "text": "API server",
      "containerId": "api",
      "fontFamily": 2
    },
    {
      "id": "db",
      "type": "diamond",
      "x": 190,
      "y": 440,
      "width": 180,
      "height": 110,
      "strokeColor": "#f08c00",
      "backgroundColor": "#ffec99",
      "fillStyle": "solid"
    },
    {
      "id": "db-label",
      "type": "text",
      "x": 190,
      "y": 440,
      "text": "Database",
      "containerId": "db",
      "fontFamily": 2
    },
    {
      "id": "client__api",
      "type": "arrow",
      "x": 280,
      "y": 192,
      "width": 0,
      "height": 86,
      "points": [
        [
          0,
          0
        ],
        [
          0,
          86
        ]
      ],
      "strokeColor": "#1971c2",
      "strokeStyle": "dashed",
      "endArrowhead": "triangle",
      "startBinding": {
        "elementId": "client",
        "focus": 0,
        "gap": 4
      },
      "endBinding": {
        "elementId": "api",
        "focus": 0,
        "gap": 4
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "api__db",
      "type": "arrow",
      "x": 280,
      "y": 352,
      "width": 0,
      "height": 86,
      "points": [
        [
          0,
          0
        ],
        [
          0,
          86
        ]
      ],
      "strokeColor": "#2f9e44",
      "endArrowhead": "triangle",
      "startBinding": {
        "elementId": "api",
        "focus": 0,
        "gap": 4
      },
      "endBinding": {
        "elementId": "db",
        "focus": 0,
        "gap": 4
      }
    }
  ]
}

See the `excaliwow://scene/authoring` resource for the full authoring guide.

folderId.description: destination folder id from list_folders (create one with create_folder); null or omitted = the root.

scene.description: raw Excalidraw scene whose elements define layout, styling, text, and connections

appState.description: Accepted but NOT persisted in v1 — always {} on read.

type.description: element type — known: rectangle, ellipse, diamond, text, arrow, line, freedraw, frame, image (others pass through)

title.description: human-readable diagram title shown in the Excaliwow workspace and editor

name: create_scene
title: Create a rich diagram (hand-authored scene)
